answer: Audits are entered in falcon, queued in garden, and jetty publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 48 identities per epoch. A farm of 186 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 842 identities would post 820 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
